public.tbl_ewb_parta.table_description: EWB Part-A PARENT batch table. One row per processed batch of e-way bills, grouped by state/period/category. Part-A detail rows (tbl_ewb_parta_ewb) roll up here via idtbl_ewb_parta. Rarely queried directly except for state/batch grouping.

columns.statecode: Numeric state code as string. E.g. '3'=Punjab, '6'=Haryana, '8'=Rajasthan, '24'=Gujarat, '27'=Maharashtra.
columns.period: Return period in MMYYYY format. OFTEN EMPTY in data — do not rely on it for filtering.

public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb.table_description: MAIN EWB Part-A table. One row per e-way bill. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing consignor/consignee (taxpayer), invoice value, distance, or EWB number. It is the ONLY table holding frgstin, togstin, ewbno. For inter-state movements (frstat <> tostat) IGST applies (igstval nonzero); for intra-state, CGST+SGST apply.

columns.ewbno: 12-digit E-Way Bill number assigned by NIC portal. Unique. E.g. '392234140001'. Bridges to Part-B via tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.ewb_no.
columns.ewbdt: EWB generation timestamp, VARCHAR in 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'. E.g. '20/04/2026 11:52:00 PM'. Use TO_TIMESTAMP(ewbdt,'DD/MM/YYYY HH12:MI:SS AM') for date math.
columns.usergstin: 15-char GSTIN of the user that generated the EWB.
columns.transtyp: Transaction type code (numeric string). '1'=Regular, '2'=Bill To-Ship To, '3'=Bill From-Dispatch From, '4'=Combination.
columns.ssuptyp: Sub-supply type code (numeric string), OFTEN PADDED with trailing spaces e.g. '1  '. TRIM before comparing or use LIKE. '1'=Supply, '8'=Others.
columns.doctyp: Backing document type. 'INV'=Tax Invoice, 'CHL'=Delivery Challan, 'BIL'=Bill of Supply.
columns.frgstin: 15-char Consignor (seller/sender) GSTIN. Use for outgoing-movement queries. Bridges to GSTR-3B/GSTR-7 gstin columns (cross-module).
columns.frplac: Consignor place — usually city/district, sometimes state name.
columns.cgstval: Total CGST on the EWB. ZERO for inter-state movements (where IGST applies).
columns.sgstval: Total SGST/UTGST on the EWB. ZERO for inter-state movements.
columns.igstval: Total IGST on the EWB. NONZERO for inter-state movements (frstat <> tostat).
columns.cessval: Total advalorem cess on the EWB. Often 0.
columns.status: Current EWB status. 'ACT'=Active, 'CNL'=Cancelled, 'EXP'=Expired. CANONICAL bill state: for 'how many e-way bills were cancelled/expired/active' COUNT bills in THIS table WHERE status='CNL'/'EXP'/'ACT' — do NOT use the Part-B canceldet event log for that count.
columns.rejstatus: Rejection status flag. Empty/blank when not rejected; non-empty when consignee has rejected the EWB.
columns.travdist: Travel distance declared in km, stored as STRING. E.g. '232'. Cast to integer for numeric comparison.
columns.InvVal: Invoice value (gross, including tax). CASE-SENSITIVE column name — MUST be referenced with double quotes ("InvVal"), else PostgreSQL folds to lowercase and the column is not found.
columns.ewbvaliddt: EWB validity expiry timestamp, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'.
columns.despfrstat: Dispatched-from state code (numeric). May differ from frstat for Bill-To/Ship-To.
columns.shiptostat: Ship-to state code (numeric). May differ from tostat for Bill-To/Ship-To.

public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb_itemlist.table_description: Item-level lines within each Part-A e-way bill. One row per HSN/item line. JOIN through idtbl_ewb_parta_ewb to tbl_ewb_parta_ewb to reach taxpayer/EWB info. For item-level tax rate or HSN queries, use this table.

columns.itemno: Line number within the EWB (string). E.g. '1', '2'.
columns.prodnam: Product/item name (free-text, OFTEN BLANK in real data).
columns.hsncod: HSN/SAC classification code. E.g. '44013100' (Wood pellets), '8471' (computers), '6109' (T-shirts). First 2 digits = chapter.
columns.qty: Quantity shipped, stored as STRING (may be decimal). E.g. '29.43'.
columns.QtyUqc: Unit of measure (Quantity Unit Code). E.g. 'MTS' (metric tonnes), 'PCS', 'KGS', 'NOS', 'MTR'. CASE-SENSITIVE — quote as "QtyUqc" when referencing.
columns.cgstrt: CGST rate applied to this item (percent). Nonzero for intra-state.
columns.sgstrt: SGST rate applied to this item (percent). Nonzero for intra-state.
columns.igstrt: IGST rate applied to this item (percent). E.g. 5, 12, 18, 28. Nonzero for inter-state.
columns.cessrt: Cess rate applied to this item (percent).
columns.assamt: Assessable (taxable) amount for this line. E.g. 208700.78.
columns.idtbl_ewb_parta_ewb: FK to tbl_ewb_parta_ewb. MUST JOIN through this for taxpayer/period info.

public.tbl_ewb_partb.table_description: EWB Part-B PARENT batch table. One row per processed batch of Part-B events, grouped by state/period/category. Part-B detail rows roll up here via idtbl_ewb_partb. NOTE the doubled-id primary key column name.

columns.ididtbl_ewb_partb: Primary key. NOTE the doubled 'id' prefix — this is the actual column name in the source DB.
columns.statecode: Numeric state code as string. E.g. '3'=Punjab.
columns.period: Return period (MMYYYY) when populated; OFTEN EMPTY.

public.tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.table_description: MAIN EWB Part-B table. One row per Part-B event packet (validity/vehicle/cancel/etc.). Linked LOGICALLY to Part-A via ewb_no = tbl_ewb_parta_ewb.ewbno (no enforced FK between Part-A and Part-B). The vehicle/cancel/extend/reject/transporter child tables join to THIS table via idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb.

columns.idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb: Primary key. Child event tables (partbdet, canceldet, extenddet, rejdtl, transdet) reference this.
columns.ewb_no: 12-digit E-Way Bill number. Use ewb_no = tbl_ewb_parta_ewb.ewbno to bridge Part-A and Part-B.
columns.fin_valid_dt: Final validity date for the EWB, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'.

public.tbl_ewb_partb_ewb_partbdet.table_description: Vehicle and transport detail per Part-B EWB. Multiple rows per EWB possible when the vehicle/transporter changes mid-route. JOIN via idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb to tbl_ewb_partb_ewb. For vehicle-number or transport-mode queries, use this table.

columns.vehno: Vehicle registration number (Indian RTO format). E.g. 'PB10KB0326', 'RJ23GC4575'.
columns.frplace: From place for this leg (mixed granularity: state, district, city, or free-text).
columns.reascd: Reason code for this Part-B update. Often blank.
columns.updid: 15-char GSTIN of the user who uploaded this update.
columns.transmode: Mode of transport code (numeric, OFTEN PADDED with trailing spaces e.g. '1  '). '1'=Road, '2'=Rail, '3'=Air, '4'=Ship. TRIM or use LIKE.
columns.trdocdt: Transporter document date, VARCHAR. Often blank.
columns.ewb_no: Denormalized EWB number (FREQUENTLY BLANK — prefer parent tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.ewb_no).
columns.valid_till_dt: Validity-till date for this leg, VARCHAR. Often blank.

public.tbl_ewb_partb_ewb_canceldet.table_description: EWB cancellation EVENT log (when/why/by whom an EWB was cancelled). TRAP: for 'how many e-way bills were cancelled' do NOT count rows here — that is the bill's state: COUNT bills in tbl_ewb_parta_ewb WHERE status='CNL' (not every cancelled bill has an event row here). Use THIS table only for cancellation details (reason/time/actor). JOIN via idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb to tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.

columns.ewb_no: Cancelled EWB number (denormalized). FREQUENTLY BLANK — JOIN through idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb to get it from tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.ewb_no.
columns.cancelreascd: Cancellation reason code (numeric string). '3'=Duplicate, '4'=Data entry error/Wrong entry.
columns.cancelreasrem: Free-text cancellation remark. E.g. 'Wrong Site selected'. Often blank.

public.tbl_ewb_partb_ewb_extenddet.table_description: EWB validity-extension EVENT log (one row per extension; a bill can be extended more than once). For 'how many e-way bills had validity extended' count DISTINCT bills (COUNT(DISTINCT the bill via the Part-B join), not COUNT(*) of event rows). JOIN via idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb to tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.

columns.extdt: Extension request timestamp, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'.
columns.extreasrem: Free-text extension remark. E.g. 'Delay', 'wait for unloading'.
columns.extby: Extension actor — usually a username or system handle (NOT always a GSTIN). E.g. 'driver001'.
columns.frplace: Current location at extension time (city/town, free-text).
columns.remdist: Remaining distance to destination in km, stored as STRING.
columns.prev_validdt: Previous validity date before the extension, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'.
columns.ewb_no: Denormalized EWB number — FREQUENTLY BLANK. JOIN through tbl_ewb_partb_ewb for the actual number.

public.tbl_ewb_partb_ewb_rejdtl.table_description: EWB rejection events: when the counterparty GSTIN rejects an EWB. Used to detect disputed/refused consignments. JOIN via idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb to tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.

columns.ewb_no: Rejected EWB number (denormalized) — FREQUENTLY BLANK. JOIN through tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.

public.tbl_ewb_partb_ewb_transdet.table_description: Transporter assignment/change events on an EWB. Captures when a new transporter is assigned (transid) or an upload is recorded. JOIN via idtbl_ewb_partb_ewb to tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.

columns.transid: 15-char GSTIN of the newly assigned transporter.
columns.updid: Uploader identifier — usually an API/system handle PADDED WITH TRAILING SPACES, sometimes a GSTIN. E.g. 'API_NBC_RJ  '. TRIM before comparing.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b.table_description: MAIN GSTR-3B table (Monthly Summary Return). One row = one filed return = one (gstin, ret_period). This is the ONLY table with gstin and ret_period; every section (supply / ITC / inward / payment) lives in child tables that reach the taxpayer+period by JOINing UP to this table via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b (2-3 hops through a section parent). There is NO pre-computed rollup here: tax liability comes from the sup_details section tables, tax paid from the tx_pmt tables. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for counting returns use COUNT(*). GEO decode: JOIN gstin = common.t_all_delers_api_v_t.gstin (name/status), then .stjd = common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code.state_jur_code for division/range/unit. FY/MONTH decode: JOIN ret_period = common.mst_3bd_months_t.ret_period_fl, then .fy_flag = common.mst_fy_years_t.flag_fy.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b: Primary key (internal return ID). JOIN KEY: every section parent (inward_sup, itc_elg, sup_details, tx_pmt) references this to reach gstin/ret_period.
columns.gstin: 15-char taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this table. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin). JOIN to common.t_all_delers_api_v_t.gstin for trade/legal name, status, and (via stjd) jurisdiction.
columns.ret_period: Return period in MMYYYY (VARCHAR). Sample: '042024'=Apr 2024, '122025'=Dec 2025. YEAR=last 4 chars, MONTH=first 2. For 'year 2025' use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for 'April' use LIKE '04%'; NEVER equality for year-only. For MONTH name / QUARTER / financial-year scoping, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl = ret_period (join on ret_period_fl, the zero-padded VARCHAR — NOT mst_3bd_months_t.ret_period, which is an INTEGER with the leading zero dropped).
columns.fil_dt: Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY (VARCHAR). Sample: '18-02-2026'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
columns.process_date: Backend processing date in YYYY-MM-DD (ISO, VARCHAR). Sample: '2026-02-18'. Different format from fil_dt — do NOT mix.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_inward_sup.table_description: Linking PARENT for the inward-supplies section (no amounts). JOIN idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b to the main table; the isup_details child joins here.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b. JOIN through this to reach gstin / ret_period.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_inward_sup_isup_d.table_description: Inward-supplies details (composition/nil-rated/exempt purchases + non-GST purchases). Two rows per return: ty='GST' and ty='NONGST'. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_inward_sup to the inward_sup parent, then to main for gstin.

columns.ty: Type of inward supply. ENUM, two values: 'GST' (composition/nil/exempt purchases) and 'NONGST' (purchases outside GST scope, e.g. petrol, alcohol).
columns.inter: Inter-State inward supplies value (purchases from other states).
columns.intra: Intra-State inward supplies value (purchases within the same state).
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_inward_sup: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_inward_sup. JOIN up through inward_sup then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg.table_description: Linking PARENT for the ITC (Input Tax Credit) section (no amounts). Bridges the main table to all ITC detail tables (itc_avl, itc_rev, itc_inelg, itc_net). JOIN idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b to main.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg: Primary key. Referenced by the four ITC detail tables.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b. JOIN through this to reach gstin / ret_period.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_avl.table_description: ITC AVAILABLE (Form 4A) — credit the taxpayer can claim. MULTIPLE rows per return, one per ty. For 'ITC available/claimed' SUM iamt/camt/samt/csamt across rows (most taxpayers populate ty='OTH' only). JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg to itc_elg, then main.

columns.ty: Type of ITC available. ENUM: 'IMPG'=Import of Goods, 'IMPS'=Import of Services, 'ISRC'=Inward supplies liable to Reverse Charge, 'ISD'=Input Service Distributor credit, 'OTH'=all other ITC (the bulk for most taxpayers).
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg. JOIN up through itc_elg then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_inelg.table_description: ITC INELIGIBLE (Form 4D) — blocked credit that CANNOT be claimed. Two rows per return (ty RUL/OTH). Almost always 0. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg to itc_elg, then main.

columns.ty: Type of ineligible ITC. ENUM: 'RUL' (Sec 17(5) blocked / Rule 42-43 reversal) and 'OTH' (other ineligible).
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg. JOIN up through itc_elg then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_net.table_description: NET ITC available (Form 4C) — final claimable credit after adjustments (available minus reversed/ineligible). ONE row per return (no ty partitioning). For 'net ITC' project/SUM iamt/camt/samt/csamt HERE directly; do NOT re-derive from avl-rev. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg to itc_elg, then main.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg. JOIN up through itc_elg then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg_itc_rev.table_description: ITC REVERSED (Form 4B) — credit taken back by the taxpayer. Two rows per return (ty RUL/OTH). Usually 0. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg to itc_elg, then main.

columns.ty: Reason for reversal. ENUM: 'RUL' (Rule 42-43 proportional reversal for exempt/personal use) and 'OTH' (other reversals).
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_itc_elg. JOIN up through itc_elg then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details.table_description: Linking PARENT for the supply-details section (no amounts). Bridges the main table to the five supply detail tables (osupdet, osupzero, osupnilexmp, osupnongst, isuprev). JOIN idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b to main.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details: Primary key. Referenced by the five supply detail tables.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b. JOIN through this to reach gstin / ret_period.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupd.table_description: OUTWARD TAXABLE supplies / liability (Form 3.1(a)) — regular taxable SALES, excluding zero-rated / nil / exempt / non-GST. This is the TURNOVER table: for 'turnover'/'taxable sales'/'outward supplies value' use txval; for 'outward tax liability' use iamt+camt+samt. One row per return. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details to sup_details, then main. (Distinct from the four sibling section tables below, which share the same columns but a different supply class.)

columns.txval: Taxable turnover value of regular outward supplies (sales). Sample: 540330.64, 1219448.00.
columns.iamt: IGST liability on inter-state sales. iamt>0 indicates inter-state activity.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details. JOIN up through sup_details then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupz.table_description: ZERO-RATED outward supplies (Form 3.1(b)) — EXPORTS + SEZ supplies (taxed 0% but ITC-eligible). One row per return. Use for 'exports'/'zero-rated', NOT for regular sales (that is osupdet). Same columns as the other section tables. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details to sup_details, then main.

columns.txval: Taxable value of zero-rated supplies (exports + SEZ).
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details. JOIN up through sup_details then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupn.table_description: NIL-RATED & EXEMPT outward supplies (Form 3.1(c)) — sales at 0% or exempt from GST (basic food, education, etc.). One row per return. Tax columns are always 0. Same columns as the other section tables. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details to sup_details, then main.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details. JOIN up through sup_details then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupn.table_description: NON-GST outward supplies (Form 3.1(e)) — sales outside the GST regime (petrol, diesel, alcohol). One row per return. Tax intrinsically 0. Same columns as the other section tables. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details to sup_details, then main.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details. JOIN up through sup_details then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_isupr.table_description: Inward supplies under REVERSE CHARGE (Form 3.1(d)) — purchases where the buyer pays GST instead of the seller. AT MOST one row per return: taxpayers with no RCM activity have NO row here (use LEFT JOIN / NOT EXISTS for 'no RCM' questions), and a row may exist with txval=0. This is the RCM liability row inside sup_details; distinct from itc_avl ty='ISRC' (the same tax claimed BACK as ITC). Same columns as the outward section tables. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details to sup_details, then main.

columns.txval: Taxable value of inward supplies liable to reverse charge.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details. JOIN up through sup_details then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt.table_description: Linking PARENT for the tax-payment section (no amounts). Bridges the main table to pd_cash and pd_itc. JOIN idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b to main.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt: Primary key. Referenced by pd_cash and pd_itc.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b. JOIN through this to reach gstin / ret_period.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt_pd_cash.table_description: Tax paid via the CASH ledger — direct payments from the electronic cash ledger. MULTIPLE rows per return (one per liability line liab_ldg_id). trans_typ '30002'=tax, '30003'=interest/late-fee/penalty. For 'tax paid in cash' SUM ipd+cpd+spd+cspd (add WHERE trans_typ='30002' to exclude interest/penalty). JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt to tx_pmt, then main.

columns.liab_ldg_id: Liability ledger ID (numeric string) identifying the obligation being paid. Sample: '975974661'.
columns.trans_typ: Transaction type code (VARCHAR). ENUM: '30002'=regular tax payment, '30003'=interest / late fee / penalty.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt. JOIN up through tx_pmt then main for gstin.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt_pd_itc.table_description: Tax paid via ITC — liability offset using available credit. MULTIPLE rows per return (one per liability line). Cross-credit columns: i_pdc = IGST liability paid using CGST credit, etc. (first letter = liability head, last letter = credit head used). For 'tax paid through ITC' SUM the *_pd* columns. JOIN via idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt to tx_pmt, then main.

columns.liab_ldg_id: Liability ledger ID (numeric string). Same series as pd_cash.
columns.trans_typ: Transaction type code. Almost always '30002' (interest/penalty cannot be paid by ITC).
columns.i_pdi: IGST liability paid using IGST credit.
columns.i_pdc: IGST liability paid using CGST credit.
columns.i_pds: IGST liability paid using SGST credit.
columns.c_pdi: CGST liability paid using IGST credit.
columns.c_pdc: CGST liability paid using CGST credit.
columns.s_pdi: SGST liability paid using IGST credit.
columns.s_pds: SGST liability paid using SGST credit.
columns.cs_pdcs: Cess liability paid using Cess credit.
columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt: FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_tx_pmt. JOIN up through tx_pmt then main for gstin.

common.t_all_delers_api_v_t.table_description: Taxpayer / GSTIN REGISTRATION master (dealer master) — ONE ROW PER GSTIN (UNIQUE gstin; a plain master, NOT a partitioned view). Supplies taxpayer IDENTITY (trade/legal name), STATUS, registration/cancellation dates, registration type, and the GEO decode for the fact modules. JOIN gstin to a fact table's taxpayer GSTIN: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b.gstin (GSTR-3B), public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.gstin (GSTR-7 deductor), or EWB frgstin/togstin/usergstin. For JURISDICTION display, JOIN stjd = common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code.state_jur_code and PROJECT division/range/unit (never the raw stjd code). 'Active' taxpayers = canc_dt IS NULL; 'cancelled' = canc_dt IS NOT NULL. Several columns are coded (authstatus, cobz, psnt, regtypecd, regtype) — their decode masters are NOT loaded; read the code per its comment, do NOT invent a decode join.

columns.gstin: 15-char GSTIN (state code + PAN + suffix). UNIQUE — one row per taxpayer. Sample: '24AABCE0002E9AA'. JOIN KEY to the fact modules' taxpayer GSTIN.
columns.lgnmbzpan: LEGAL / registered name of the firm (per PAN). For a company/firm NAME filter, match this with ILIKE (case-insensitive partial) OR'd with trdnm — the name may sit in either column. Sample: 'Rashtriya Ispath Nigam Ltd'.
columns.trdnm: TRADE name (brand / operating name) — a firm NAME, NOT a business category. Primary column for company/'trade name' filters: ILIKE and OR with lgnmbzpan. Sample: 'Vizag Steel'.
columns.appr_auth: Approving authority: 'CENTER' or 'STATE' (or NULL). Note: stjd alone does not indicate center-vs-state.
columns.stjd: State jurisdiction code — JOIN KEY to common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code.state_jur_code for division/range/unit. Sample: 'GJ063'. Do NOT project this raw code when the officer wants a jurisdiction NAME.
columns.rgtodt: GST registration validity END date (DATE). Set when the registration has an end: cancelled taxpayers AND casual/temporary registrations (iscasdl='Y' — validity-window end while still active). NOT a cancellation indicator — for cancelled-vs-active use canc_dt; rgtodt may differ from canc_dt on the same row.
columns.canc_dt: GST CANCELLATION date (DATE). NULL = active/not cancelled; NOT NULL = cancelled. Use for 'active' (IS NULL) vs 'cancelled' (IS NOT NULL) taxpayers — the ONLY cancellation column (not rgtodt).
columns.iscasdl: Casual dealer/taxpayer flag: 'Y' = casual (temporary, time-bound registration; rgtodt holds its validity END even while active), 'N' = regular.
columns.authstatus: Registration status CODE. Sample: 'A' (active), 'SC', 'CBT'. Coded — decode master NOT loaded; read as-is, do NOT invent a join.
columns.cobz: Constitution of business CODE. Sample: 'PRO' (proprietorship), 'PAR' (partnership), 'SCT'. Coded — decode master NOT loaded.
columns.psnt: Nature of premises possession CODE. Sample: 'OWN', 'REN'/'RENT', 'CON' (consent). Coded — decode master NOT loaded.
columns.ntcrbs: Nature of CORE business activity — the activity CATEGORY (Manufacturer/Retailer/Trader/Wholesaler/Service Provider/Distributor). NOT the firm's name — never filter a taxpayer/trade NAME here (use trdnm/lgnmbzpan).
columns.can_type: Cancellation type. Sample: 'Suo-moto Cancellation', 'Voluntary Cancellation'. Populated only for cancelled taxpayers.
columns.can_reasons: Cancellation reason (free-text). Populated only for cancelled taxpayers.

common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code.table_description: Jurisdiction DECODE master: state_jur_code -> division / range / unit (officer-readable jurisdiction names). 1:1 lookup (UNIQUE state_jur_code). LEFT JOIN target only: common.t_all_delers_api_v_t.stjd = state_jur_code. PROJECT division/range/unit for officer-facing jurisdiction; never the raw code.

columns.division: Division NAME — top-level officer jurisdiction. Project for 'division'. Sample: 'Division 5 (VAD)'.
columns.range: Range NAME — mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). Project for 'range'. Sample: 'Range 10 (VAD)'. RESERVED WORD — reference as "range" (double-quoted) or PostgreSQL folds/errors.
columns.unit: Unit NAME — lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). Project for 'unit'/'ghatak'. Sample: 'Ghatak 41 (VAD)'. Can filter with unit ILIKE 'Ghatak 41 (%'.

common.mst_fy_years_t.table_description: Decode master: financial-year flag -> FY label. 1:1 lookup (UNIQUE flag_fy), LEFT JOIN target only. NO fact table carries fy_flag directly anymore — reach it through the MONTH master: JOIN tbl_gst_rtn_r3b.ret_period = common.mst_3bd_months_t.ret_period_fl, then common.mst_3bd_months_t.fy_flag = mst_fy_years_t.flag_fy. Project desc_year (AS financial_year) for display; use flag_fy for WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY.

columns.flag_fy: Financial-year flag integer. JOIN KEY <-> mst_3bd_months_t.fy_flag. Sample: 8=FY2024-25, 9=FY2025-26 (domain 1=FY2017-18 ... 11=FY2027-28).
columns.desc_year: Financial-year LABEL for display. Sample: '2024-25', '2025-26'. Project THIS (AS financial_year) in place of the raw flag.

common.mst_3bd_months_t.table_description: Decode master: return period (MMYYYY) -> month name / quarter, AND the AUTHORITATIVE month->financial-year mapping. 1:1 lookup (UNIQUE ret_period_fl), LEFT JOIN target only. JOIN tbl_gst_rtn_r3b.ret_period = ret_period_fl (the zero-padded VARCHAR). Carries fy_flag -> chain to mst_fy_years_t.flag_fy for the FY label. Use fy_flag for financial-year scoping (Apr-Mar); NEVER derive FY from the calendar year inside ret_period — e.g. ret_period '032025' (March 2025) is fy_flag 8 = FY2024-25, not calendar 2025.

columns.ret_period_fl: Return period MMYYYY, zero-padded VARCHAR. JOIN KEY <-> tbl_gst_rtn_r3b.ret_period. Sample: '032026', '122025'.
columns.month_desc: Month NAME for display. Sample: 'March', 'January', 'April'. Project THIS for the month label.
columns.mnth_cd: Calendar month number 1-12. Sample: 3=March, 1=January. Use for chronological month sort within a financial year.
columns.quarter: GST quarter label, populated ONLY on the quarter's CLOSING month (Jun->Q1, Sep->Q2, Dec->Q3, Mar->Q4); blank on the other two months. For an every-row quarter key use quarter_all_mnths.
columns.quarter_all_mnths: Quarter key present on EVERY month: the MMYYYY of the quarter's closing month (Jan/Feb/Mar 2026 all -> '032026'). Use to GROUP BY quarter across all three months.
columns.fy_flag: Financial-year flag for this return period. JOIN KEY <-> mst_fy_years_t.flag_fy. Sample: 9=FY2025-26. Authoritative month->FY mapping (resolves the calendar-vs-FY boundary).

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.table_description: MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.

columns.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7: Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
columns.fp: Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
columns.gstin: 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
columns.fil_dt: Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
columns.inserted_date: Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds.table_description: GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.

columns.gstin_ded: 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
columns.amt_ded: TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
columns.iamt: IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
columns.camt: CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
columns.samt: SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
columns.tbl_gst_rtn_r7: FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses.
columns.deductee_name: Trade name of the deductee (often blank on older rows).
columns.idt: Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank on older TDS rows; see tds_inv).

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv.table_description: GSTR-7 TDS invoice-level breakdown: one row per invoice line under a TDS deductee row. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (for the deductee), then to main (for deductor/period).

columns.inum: Invoice number (free-form). May be numeric or alphanumeric e.g. 'ME/25-26/464'.
columns.amt_ded: Amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
columns.flag: Per-row flag ('N','Y' or blank). Feed-specific meaning.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa.table_description: GSTR-7 TDS Amendment data: revisions to TDS rows reported in PRIOR periods. Each row carries BOTH original (o* columns) and revised values. The original period is in omonth (MMYYYY); the amendment itself belongs to the parent tbl_gst_rtn_r7.fp period. Use for 'TDS corrections/amendments' questions. JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.

columns.ogstin_ded: ORIGINAL deductee GSTIN as previously reported. May be empty when only the amount was amended.
columns.omonth: ORIGINAL return period being amended, MMYYYY. E.g. '102025'.
columns.oamt_ded: ORIGINAL amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
columns.gstin_ded: REVISED deductee GSTIN (corrected value); or same as ogstin_ded when only the amount changed.
columns.amt_ded: REVISED amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
columns.source: Source code of the amendment ('C','D'). Feed-specific; meaning not authoritatively documented.
columns.tbl_gst_rtn_r7: FK to main table (column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`, no `id` prefix — same quirk as TDS table).
columns.idt: Revised invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
columns.inum: Revised invoice number (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
columns.ival: Revised invoice value (often blank; see tdsa_inv).

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa_inv.table_description: GSTR-7 TDSA invoice-level breakdown. Mirrors tds_inv but carries ORIGINAL (o*) and REVISED columns side by side. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa.

columns.omonth: ORIGINAL period MMYYYY (often blank — carried on the parent tdsa row).
columns.oamt_ded: ORIGINAL amount deducted on the invoice.
columns.gstin_ded: REVISED deductee GSTIN (often blank when only amount amended).
columns.amt_ded: REVISED amount deducted on the invoice.
columns.iamt: REVISED IGST withheld for this invoice.
columns.oival: ORIGINAL invoice value (stored as TEXT here, unlike tds_inv.ival).
columns.inum: REVISED invoice number. Often equals oinum when only amount corrected.
columns.ival: REVISED invoice value (TEXT). Often equals oival when only amount corrected.

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_pay.table_description: GSTR-7 Tax PAYABLE — declared liability for the return. Multiple rows per return (one per liab_id). The igst_*/cgst_*/sgst_*/cess_* columns break liability into tax/interest/penalty/fee/others. JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`. Contrast with tax_paid_pd_by_cash (actual settlement).

columns.liab_id: Liability ID (numeric string). Sequential per liability obligation.
columns.tbl_gst_rtn_r7: FK to main table (column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` — same FK-naming quirk).

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid.table_description: GSTR-7 parent JOIN table for tax-paid settlements. Holds no payment data itself; bridges tbl_gst_rtn_r7 to per-mode payment detail tables (currently only pd_by_cash). One row per return per payment block.

columns.tbl_gst_rtn_r7: FK to main table (column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` — FK-naming quirk).

public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid_pd_by_cas.table_description: GSTR-7 tax actually PAID via cash ledger — settlement records against liabilities declared in tax_pay. Multiple rows per return (one per debit_id). Same igst/cgst/sgst/cess breakdown as tax_pay. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid, then to main, to reach deductor and period. Match liab_id to tax_pay.liab_id when reconciling payable vs paid.

columns.liab_id: Liability ID being settled. Match to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_pay.liab_id.
columns.debit_id: Debit reference ID from the cash ledger. Format 'DC'+DDMMYY+sequence.
